llm_response.reason: The website impersonates the Wellensteyn clothing brand but uses an unrelated domain name (astridgrass.shop) and lacks legally-required company ownership information typical for German online shops. The site uses urgency tactics (clearance, sales) and low prices to attract buyers. Multiple independent sources and online warnings identify astridgrass.shop as a scam website. These factors match several scam website characteristics: brand spoofing, lack of transparency, urgency tactics, and being publicly reported as a fraud.
